Set and Earn on BNB Chain, first full week (Oct 1 to Oct 8 00:00 UTC):

4,752 new ERC-8004 agents, 1,131 on a campaign marketplace.
10,734 hires, 10,325 of them on TermiX.
7 wallets hired 3+ agents across 2+ marketplaces we could attribute, up from 5.

20 agents now clear our hire check: 3+ completed hires from 3+ wallets with no funding link found within 4 hops.

16 of them sit in the closed 48-wallet TermiX ring from our week-one decode. It ran a fourth full round on Oct 6 and hired no one outside itself all week.

Week one asked: would 302 new TermiX registrants, first funded from exchange-style hot wallets on Oct 2, go on to hire?

They did. On Oct 3, 300 of them each hired one TermiX agent, a median 85 seconds after registering their own, for about 99% of their USDC.

That USDC came from two exchange-style hot wallets that sent USDC to 8,117 wallets that day, so the address alone links nothing.

The amounts stand out: all 300 got $80 to $120, the same band as September's last two bursts on BNB Chain. Under 10% of the rest did.

As of 12:06 UTC Oct 8, 1 of 51 campaign-week ERC-8183 hires on mainnet had completed: the first 7-day dispute window ended at 09:25 UTC and the job completed 71 seconds later.
